standard_prerequisites.name: The norm compatibility of the pushforward of a principal divisor
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-proper-pushforward-alteration (proof lines 4613 and 4624, claimed as S14-algebra-pushforward-alteration)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the equality of cycles for the divisor of a rational function on an integral scheme, from which the statement follows after reducing to the case of the structure sheaf.

core_obligations: Deduce the last equation from the first, since the pushforward of the fundamental class is the degree times the fundamental class by definition (proof lines 4610-4612).

Reduce to the structure sheaf: the equality is one of cycles, so one may work locally on the target and assume the invertible sheaf is the structure sheaf, in which case the section corresponds to a rational function (proof lines 4612-4618).
Conclude by the norm compatibility statement, since the norm of a rational function from the base is its degree-th power (proof lines 4619-4627).
proof_roadmap: The last equation from the first (proof lines 4610-4612).
Local reduction to the structure sheaf (proof lines 4612-4618).
Norm compatibility and the degree-th power (proof lines 4619-4627).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pushforward of the divisor of a pulled back meromorphic section as the degree of the function field extension times the divisor of the section, and deduces the corresponding statement for the first Chern class (statement lines 4589-4608, tag 02SR-adjacent). The proof deduces the last equation from the first, reduces to the case of the structure sheaf by working locally, and applies the norm compatibility statement together with the fact that the norm of a rational function from the base is its degree-th power. The reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
